id: \bCaptured Pokémon are registered with an ID No. and the OT.
en: \bCaptured Pokémon are registered with an ID No.  and the OT.
it: \bI Pokémon catturati vengono registrati con un N. ID e un AO.

id: \bI can teach your Pokémon a very powerful move, Signal Beam!
en: \bI can teach your Pokémon a very powerful move, Signal Beam!
it: \bPosso insegnare ai tuoi Pokémon una mossa potentissima: Segnoraggio!

id: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
en: \bWhich Pokémon would you like me to teach?
it: \bA quale Pokémon vuoi che la insegni?

id: \bAll right!\nMy buddy's going to trade me his Magmar for my Electabuzz!
en: \bAll right!\nMy buddy's going to trade me his Magmar for my Electabuzz!
it: \bEvvai!\nIl mio amico mi scambierà il suo Magmar con il mio Electabuzz!

id: \bMy Electabuzz evolved but his Magmar didn't. Did we forget something?
en: \bMy Electabuzz evolved but his Magmar didn't. Did we forget something?
it: \bIl mio Electabuzz si è evoluto, ma il suo Magmar no. Ci siamo dimenticati qualcosa?
